exploration.description: A low, dusty antechamber with a cracked pillar and rubble from a collapsed ceiling. Two heavy doors lead on: one east, one south.

events.description: Bones are stacked in niches along the walls; a shallow pool of black water fills the middle. An old iron-bound chest stands in the corner.
A long hall with a stone sarcophagus, two pillars, braziers that still glow and a dark altar. In the far corner a narrow stair leads down into the depths.

exploration.description: A low, dusty antechamber with a cracked pillar and rubble from a collapsed ceiling. Two heavy doors lead on: one east, one south.

rooms.description: The stairs from the crypt end in a cold chamber. Scratched warnings cover the walls; a heavy door leads east, a barred door south. Faint chanting rises from below.
A narrow hall around an open sarcophagus. The torchlight does not reach the corners, and the darkness there moves. A wide gap in the south wall opens onto the sanctum.

A vaulted sanctum with a black altar, braziers burning with green flame and a pool of dark water. A robed necromancer stands at the altar with the stolen dead at his side; the grimoire lies open before him.
